[Erowid note:
Death of Dean Coldwell
]
Today is the first aniversary of the death of Dean Coldwell, He died after using Ketamine with friends. His friends did not take any more than him, and they experienced nothing out of the ordinary. He was 22 years old, with the world at his fingertips. He was buried in Horsted Keynes Graveyard, and had a memorial bench donated to his favorite pub, the Crown in Horsted Keynes, Sussex, Britain. Doctors were unable to determine the cause of death, but a sample of the ketamine was tested and found to be pure. He was a close family friend, and I would just like people to be aware of this before taking ketamine.
